# A test copy of admission-matrix.tsv with two cells written wrong on purpose,
# and one written right beside them. AdmissionMatrixIT runs these against the
# service on every build and must report exactly the two wrong ones: that is
# the red state of the comparison, observed rather than claimed.
#   claim by a console identity on an open task: the service refuses it, the
#   release by the console identity that commissioned an active task: the
#   service refuses it as CLAIM_HELD, the row says ROLE_INSUFFICIENT (a wrong
#   claim by an executor on an open task: written right, never reported.
